fact: In a 3 October 2025 government statement, the DCDT's Deputy Director for Cybersecurity Operations described the National Cybersecurity Hub as a CSIRT hosted by the department that works with SAPS on cybercrime investigations and with ISPA on fraudulent website takedowns, and the Hawks said cybersecurity matters await the forthcoming Cybersecurity Bill.
title: Government urges vigilance against rising cyber threats
